about: Front RU0: Russian strings that may equal their English source or hold no Cyrillic letter, each with a reason (plan front-i18n-ru.md §5.4). Keys are the lint's string ids: `catalog:<key>`, `map:<id>.<path>`, `original:<normalised original>`.

entries.catalog:app.name: product name (OpenVireo)
entries.original:HH:MM:SS: a format token (hours, minutes, seconds), kept as VIREO writes it
entries.original:V - Mv =: a formula (V − Mv), kept as VIREO writes it
entries.original:PEpoch (MJD):: a pulsar catalogue parameter name (ATNF PEpoch, MJD), kept as VIREO writes it
entries.catalog:siteClock.utValue: a time value with the UT abbreviation, as the observatory clock writes it (UT kept in Russian astronomy usage)
entries.catalog:horizon.degrees: a number with the degree sign
entries.catalog:htl.row: a format of three values joined by ·
entries.catalog:cameraPrepare.catalogEntry: a format of a filter letter, a catalogue name and a band
entries.map:camera.accessReason.ready: empty: no reason when the camera is ready
entries.map:camera.sourceWithHash: a format: a label, SHA-256 and a hash
entries.map:camera.rowCounts: a format of three numbers joined by /
